public_rationale: Marcus said ChatGPT's new scheduling feature needed to be reliable and would not be. After launch, a Tom's Guide hands-on review found Tasks pushed a reminder back 12 hours and overwrote one scheduled task with another. Users on OpenAI's own forum reported tasks that never followed up, in January 2025. Another reported in December 2025 that tasks did not run on schedule at all. No independent evidence shows the feature running near-flawlessly. On the plain reading, the forecast held for the feature as shipped.
limitations: The evidence is anecdotal; there is no measured failure rate.
No deadline was stated, so this rests on the stated early-resolution rule.
